P1.2.text: As a premier potato & fries company, we manufacture innovative frozen potato, appetizer and vegetable products. Discover our products now.

P1.3.text: Introducing the first frozen par-fried olive oil fry and tot in U.S. foodservice.

P1.7.text: Three options for the highest quality fries

P1.10.text: A wide variety of potato products to meet every operator's needs

P1.11.text: Discover the crowd pleaser to keep customers coming back for more.

P1.12.text: Right products to enhance every meal.

P1.14.text: We’re committed to more sustainable packaging because it helps our operators win guest loyalty—and it reduces the amount of trash going to landfills. That’s what we call a win-win.

P1.16.text: Explore our growing regions to learn how their unique combinations of sun, water, soil, and temperature come together to create perfect potatoes.

P1.17.text: Sample a bite of our delicious history

P1.18.text: Learn how fries can boost your business

P1.19.text: Check out the latest recipes and resources

P1.20.text: We put acres of intention into every single fry and potato product. If you're looking for a partner that cares just as much as you do about what goes on your customers' plates, reach out to a Lamb Weston Fry Expert to get started.

P1.21.text: Contact a Fry Expert Explore Our Premium Promise

P2.1.text: Our history as a potato & frozen food company | Lamb Weston | Lamb Weston

P2.2.text: Manufacturing the perfect potato and frozen food products is our job, so you can focus on running your business. Discover more about how we do it.

P2.3.text: Just as the best recipes are made from the best ingredients, the best fries come from the best potatoes.

P2.5.text: This allows us to manufacture dependable consistently high-quality frozen food & frozen potatoes. After all, we believe care is best demonstrated through action.

P2.6.text: And that single minded passion and expertise fuels our pursuit for potato perfection. We pride ourselves on thinking differently and seeing the possibilities in potatoes. Not just in what they can become, but also in what they can do for you and your customers.

P2.7.text: We grow on Lamb Weston owned farmland located in the Pacific Northwest, an area recognized for growing some of the world's finest potatoes. The science and information harvested here is exchanged with our worldwide grower partners to continuously set new standards for your potatoes and fries.

P2.8.text: To help you delight your customers, thousands of Lamb Weston potato experts around the world are hard at work growing, harvesting and processing potatoes into the delicious options your guests crave. With processing facilities located close to where we grow, you can count on the right potato, getting to the right facility to be made into the potato products you need to make your menu stand out. These are the things that make us a premium frozen food supplier for restaurants all around the world.

P2.9.text: Our timeline showcases the years of service, dedication, and innovation that made Lamb Weston® who we are today.

P3.1.text: Frozen French Fries & Potato Appetizers | Lamb Weston | Lamb Weston

P3.2.text: Lamb Weston offers a variety of quality frozen potato products made from premium potatoes. Our sweet potatoes, french fries, appetizers and meals consistently deliver great taste.
